messages:
Tanya: heads up, I rolled the infra RBAC cleanup at 08:55 and spotted some controller errors in staging at 09:03. no obvious downtime but errors in the gpu-pool controller logs.

Lee: thanks for flagging. can you paste the controller error?

Tanya: log snippet:
```
E2026-03-18T09:03:12 controller.go:211] sync failed: pods "" is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:infra:gpu-controller-sa" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "gpu-pool"
```

backend-oncall: oncall here. that 403 matches a missing RoleBinding. did the refactor collapse some bindings?

Tanya: I removed the old infra:shared-role and split it into smaller roles. I thought gpu-controller had its own binding but looks like a binding reference was left pointing to the old role.

platform: we also flipped gateway KMS to impersonate a cluster-level gateway SA this morning. getting a few Cloud KMS 403s in the telemetry.

kms-bot: CloudKMS error example: 
{"time":"2026-03-18T09:04:00Z","principal":"serviceAccount:infra-gateway@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","method":"Encrypt","status":"PERMISSION_DENIED"}

Tanya: oh great, so two distinct surface areas impacted: k8s pod listing for gpu-controller and KMS ACLs for gateway. both due to refactor/rollout today.

backend-oncall: quick mitigation proposal: re-create a temporary Role in namespace gpu-pool (get/list/watch pods) and bind it to system:serviceaccount:infra:gpu-controller-sa with an expiry annotation. similar for gateway: grant needed KMS role to the mapped cloud SA for 15-30m. anyone object to temp fixes?

Lee: +1 to temp fixes. do add an expiry annotation and open a rollback/cleanup ticket. also run `kubectl auth can-i` to validate before/after.

Tanya: running checks now:
```
kubectl auth can-i list pods --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:gpu-controller-sa -n gpu-pool
no
kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:gateway-sa -n infra
no
```

platform: applying temp Role and RoleBinding for gpu-controller now, namespaced and annotated `rbac.redwood/temporary=true` and `rbac.redwood/expires=2026-03-18T09:30:00Z`. will also add audit comment.

kms-bot: applied KMS ACL for infra-gateway cloud SA on key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/inference-key` for 30m.

backend-oncall: controllers recovered after the rolebind. scheduler resumed allocations, metric noise subsided.

Tanya: thanks. immediate mitigation done. long-term we need: 1) permanent per-component roles with least privilege, 2) CI gating to run SA auth matrix pre-merge (kubectl auth can-i across SAs for critical verbs), 3) k8s audit policy changes to record impersonation and request headers, and 4) mapping doc K8s SA -> cloud SA -> required cloud IAM roles for KMS.

Lee: agree. add an automated smoke test that executes a small action per controller (e.g., list pods as gpu-controller SA) in staging after deploys. that catches this early.

platform: for auditability we should ensure k8s audit policy includes requestBody/responseStatus and user.extras fields so we can surface the impersonated principal in the clusterside logs and tie it to cloud audit logs. also enable KMS request metadata fields (`callerIp`, `oauthScope`, `authenticatedPrincipal`) in cloud audit.

Tanya: action items from this thread:
- Tanya: open PR split-rbac/component-roles with explicit Role + RoleBinding manifests for gpu-controller, gpu-allocator, gateway, node-provisioner.
- Lee: add CI job `ci/sa-auth-matrix` that runs the can-i matrix against a staging cluster pre-merge.
- Platform: update cluster audit policy and coordinate with infra to enable extra KMS metadata in cloud audit.
- backend-oncall: create alert rule: spike of 403s from principals matching `system:serviceaccount:*` -> auto-create incident.

security-bot: INC-2026-474 created, label=access_regression, priority=P1, owner=backend-oncall

Tanya: I'll also include a small kb in the security runbook about safe RBAC refactors: 1) list all SAs that reference the role, 2) run can-i matrix in a dry-run cluster, 3) stage the split with progressively narrower bindings, 4) run smoke controllers.

Lee: please include a note to avoid changing KMS impersonation mapping and RBAC in the same deployment window—makes root cause harder to determine.

backend-oncall: we'll keep the incident open until component-role PRs land and the temp bindings are removed automatically. I'll schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow and record timeline + remediation.

Tanya: removed the temp RoleBinding at 09:28 (it was annotated), verified no regression after removal. PRs incoming. thanks for fast responses everyone.

security-bot: INC-2026-474 status=mitigated, owner=backend-oncall
